title: On LCK Geometry of Gauduchon Connections
summary: It is not a priori clear which of the Gauduchon connections is better suited to LCK and Vaisman manifolds. We thus investigate the geometry of these connections through Einstein problems and more general analytic and cohomological conditions on their Ricci tensors. Our results single out the Bismut connection as the privileged one for the non-Kähler lcK and Vaisman geometry. We therefore study the {second-Bismut--Einstein} equation and provide a characterization of these structures on Hopf manifolds.
